_purpose: Method G — InfoNCE / SimCLR contrastive (van den Oord 2018). Replace L_C=E||z_A-z_B||^2 with a mutual-information lower bound that is invariant to any invertible transformation on either side, so basis-mismatch dissolves automatically. Built post-hoc on the §5.7 baseline at lambda_C=1.0 (same substrate as AC and F). PASS_GATE 4-gate evaluator (c1/pass_linear/pass_cka/pass_transfer) per the original spec.
_notes: Hyperparameters of the underlying §5.7 baseline (ssl_epochs, ft_epochs, ft_lr, n_seeds_per_config, n_eval_seeds, lambda_c=1.0) intentionally identical to AC and F so the base (zA_pre, zB_pre) substrate is byte-equivalent and G's marginal benefit is isolated on the same L_C-aligned base.

G architecture per spec methods/method-G-infonce.md: per-pathway projection MLP enc(z_pre 32-d) -> hidden=64 -> z_proj=16-d (no shared head — independent encoders, since basis-invariance of InfoNCE means we don't need a tied bottleneck like AC). Per-pathway decoder z_proj(16) -> hidden=64 -> z_pre_recon(32) acts as the L_A, L_B 'predictive' losses in the spec's L_A + L_B + lambda_C * L_InfoNCE total.

InfoNCE loss (van den Oord 2018): symmetric cross-entropy over a (B, B) cosine-similarity matrix scaled by 1/tau with diagonal targets. Loss = 0.5 * (CE_a_to_b + CE_b_to_a). Cosine similarity normalizes z_proj per row before the dot product, so encoder norms are not constrained to unit (we record raw norms separately to detect collapse per spec failure mode 2).

Hyperparameter sweep per spec: tau in {0.07, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0} x lambda_C in {0.1, 1.0, 10.0} -> 12 cells. Each cell run with seed g_sweep_seed=80001 (single seed for cell selection); pick best cell by lowest val InfoNCE on the 30% test slice (NOT total val_loss, since recon may dominate at large lambda_C). Then run 20 seeds (g_seed_base=80011..80030) on the best cell for paired-bootstrap CI.

Optimizer: Adam lr=3e-4, 30 epochs per spec. Batch size cfg=256 per spec; effective batch is min(cfg, n_train); at 70% head split of n=540 we have n_train=378 so effective batch is 378 (full-batch SGD). InfoNCE lower bound on B negatives is log(B); recorded with saturation_warning if best-seed InfoNCE is within 5% of log(B) (no learning) AND a near-floor warning if within 5% of log(B) (model is at the trivial-prediction floor).

Spec failure mode 1 (saturation when true MI(z_A; z_B) > log(B) bits): tracked via val_info_nce per cell + per best seed; lower_bound=log(n_train_eff) recorded for owner inspection. With n_train_eff=378, log(378)~=5.93 nats — generous compared to spec's batch=256/log(256)~=5.55 nats.
Spec failure mode 2 (cosine-norm collapse): raw ||z_a||, ||z_b|| means/stds recorded at-eval on test split. Diagnostic flag, does NOT auto-trigger HONEST_NEGATIVE.
Spec failure mode 3 (tau sensitivity): {0.07, 0.1} expected sweet spot per SimCLR conventions; {0.5, 1.0} included to verify the cell sweep finds the right tau.

PASS_GATE applied to z_proj_a, z_proj_b (NOT raw z_pre) on the 30% test slice. Per-bit logreg probes trained on 70% head_train, evaluated for within-pathway AUROC and cross-pathway transfer AUROC. CKA on test split with 1000-bootstrap CI. Same head_split_seed=271828 as AC/F/D3/D4.

DEVIATION FROM SPEC documented in run.py docstring + result JSON: spec describes joint encoder retraining (replacing L_C in §5.7 training); MVP is post-hoc projection heads on top of L_C-aligned baseline latents. Mirrors AC and F's post-hoc choices for tractability. delta_1 / epsilon_2 not computed (require §5.7-specific quantities not exposed by build_baseline_pair); pass_linear forced FALSE.
HONEST_NEGATIVE conditions: n_eval_paired<100; ALL 12 cells produce non-finite val_loss; ALL 20 seeds on best cell NaN.

Combined D1+D2+D3+D4+AC+F evidence preserved verbatim in state.gating.evidence and history. F PASS already sets the paper headline (cka=0.9311 / lower_ratio=0.9906 at iVAE best cell lambda_C=0.0 beta=0.5). G runs as a robustness check: does InfoNCE *also* PASS (paper claims auxiliary-conditioning OR contrastive both work — robust headline) or does only F PASS (paper headline narrows to 'iVAE-with-u prior is the working fix')? D2 cos_rsa=0.1276 is a potential warning: cosine-direction geometry is low rank-correlated across pathways, which could limit InfoNCE's contrastive signal.
